rows.freq_text:
F-REQ-IAM-34: Service Hub must display Atlas service content when the resolved customer context has an active Atlas subscription.
F-REQ-IAM-35: Service Hub must display the defined no-product page or message when the resolved customer context has no active Atlas subscription.
F-REQ-IAM-36: Service Hub must display the defined empty state when no services are available for the resolved customer context.
F-REQ-IAM-37: Service Hub must display the defined error state when Marketplace data is unavailable.
F-REQ-IAM-38: Service Hub must display clear user messaging for the no-product state, empty state and error state.
rows.ea_source_text: SREQ-MKP-06: [4.2 Marketplace / AppDirect] Marketplace / AppDirect shall provide active Atlas subscription data required for ServiceHub to display Atlas service content.
rows.assessment: Oba řádky sdružují pět FREQ IAM-34–38. MKP-06 poskytuje active Atlas data, MKP-07 availability/error status. Samostatně tím nepokrývají všech pět SH zobrazovacích pravidel.
rows.next_action: Rozpadnout důkaz pro jednotlivé FREQ. UX no-product/empty/error patří do SH; MP má dodávat odpovídající data či stav.
